concept: Old-school Jewish deli warmth: a hearty deli-red primary paired with pickle-green and mustard-gold accents over warm cream paper and dark charcoal ink. Nostalgic, appetizing, and sturdy, like a hand-painted storefront sign and a stacked pastrami on rye.
contrastNotes: All required ratios pass WCAG-AA. ink #221C15 on bg #FBF5E9 = 15.53:1 (>=7); ink-soft #5C4F40 on bg = 7.30:1 (>=4.5); white on primary #A81F2B = 7.25:1 (>=4.5); primary on bg = 6.68:1 (>=3). Extras: ink on surface = 16.33:1 and on surface-alt = 13.88:1; white on primary-dark #7E1620 = 10.38:1; secondary #3F5C26 on bg = 6.98:1 with white-on-secondary = 7.58:1; accent #A8740F on bg = 3.74:1 (usable for large text/icons/UI accents).
